THE USEFUL DETAILS

A few things you
might be wondering.

Planning your first visit or putting together a wholesale list? Start here, or speak with us directly.

Ask us on WhatsApp ↗
Where is Essence Wholesale Foods?+

Find us at Unit 28, Enterprise Park Industrial Estate, Woodbourn Road, Sheffield S9 3JL, United Kingdom. Use our directions link and look for Unit 28 on arrival.

How do I check a product or a particular brand?+

Search the ingredient guide, add relevant items to your enquiry and include the brand, quantity and pack size in your notes. You can also ask about products outside the guide. Call or WhatsApp +44 7402 342704 for confirmation.

Are all the products shown currently in stock?+

The website is an ingredient discovery guide, not a live inventory. Photos show representative ingredients and serving ideas. Please confirm stock, specifications and prices with our team before making a journey or planning an order.

Can I discuss wholesale or regular requirements?+

Yes — use the wholesale planner to describe your shop, kitchen or event, your quantities and how often you need them. Ask our team about pack sizes, pricing, minimum quantities and any account requirements.

Can I order and pay on this website?+

This website helps you prepare an enquiry. It does not process payments or place orders. Review your list and send it yourself through WhatsApp, or call us to discuss the details.

Do you offer delivery or collection?+

Please contact us with your postcode, quantities and required date to discuss available arrangements. Delivery areas, fees, collection times and minimum quantities need to be confirmed directly.

What are your opening hours?+

Please call or WhatsApp +44 7402 342704 to confirm the current opening hours before travelling. Published hours will be added once confirmed.

Can you help with dietary or ingredient requirements?+

Tell us the exact product and requirement when you enquire. Check the current packaging for ingredients and allergen information. Dietary suitability, certification and product details should be confirmed for the specific item you choose.

LET’S GET YOUR LIST TOGETHER

Your food enquiry

Save the ingredients you’re interested in, then share your list on WhatsApp or bring it to our Sheffield premises. WhatsApp opens a draft for you to review and send. Your list stays on this device until you choose to share it; it isn’t an order.

Open WhatsApp draft ↗
Visit us to discuss your list ↗

Your privacy

This website stores your enquiry list and notes in this browser only. The list is not automatically sent to Essence Wholesale Foods. Choosing “Open WhatsApp draft” shares the list and notes with WhatsApp so you can review and send the message yourself. Your quantities, shopping purpose and wholesale brief are also stored on this device. You can clear this information using “Clear list & notes” in your enquiry.

Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts. Directions open Google Maps in a new tab, where Google’s privacy policy applies. WhatsApp links open WhatsApp, where its privacy policy applies. There is no analytics or payment processing on this website.
